WITH driver_totals AS (
  SELECT driverId,
         SUM(CAST(points AS REAL)) AS total_points,
         AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps
  FROM results
  WHERE grid >= 12
  GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_points_total,
       AVG(avg_laps) AS average_of_average_laps
FROM driver_totals;
